findings.location: Paragraph with heading 'Avoid a luxurious life.' (around line containing that heading)
findings.source_quote: Avoid a luxurious life. My children, do not desire the luxuries of fine food or wine.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the heading into Portuguese and match the register used throughout (e.g. "Evitem uma vida luxuosa." or "Evitem a vida luxuosa."). Preserve surrounding HTML tags and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Avoid a vida luxuosa. Meus filhos, não desejeis as luxúrias de boa comida ou vinho.

findings.location: Multiple paragraphs (various imperatives and pronouns) — opening greeting and many admonitions
findings.source_quote: Grace, peace, and mercy from God, the Father, and the Lord, Jesus Christ, to my dear children... First, I admonish you, my most beloved children, always allow yourselves to be instructed...
findings.suggested_fix: Make pronominal/register usage consistent in Portuguese. The translation mixes 'vós' (e.g. 'admoesto-vos', 'sede') with 'tu' forms and modern plural 'vocês' forms ('tua', 'tuas', 'sejas'). Choose one register (suggestion: use plural formal 'vós' rarely used in modern Portuguese — better: use plural polite 'vocês' or consistently use 'vós'/'vosso') and apply it throughout. Do not change HTML structure or scripture rendering.
findings.translation_quote: Translation mixes 'vós' and 'tu' forms across paragraphs (examples: 'admoesto-vos', 'guardai vossa língua', then later 'Guarda tua língua.', 'Tu és o mais velho; aprende sabedoria, para que sejas...').

findings.location: Paragraph near end: final signature line
findings.source_quote: written in haste (while trembling with cold), out of love for you all, amen.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the parenthetical phrasing into idiomatic Portuguese and fix word form: replace '(tremer de frio)' with '(tremendo de frio)' or '(tremendo de frio)'. Preserve HTML tags and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Escrito por mim, Soetgen van den Houte, vossa mãe em grilhões; escrito às pressas (tremer de frio), por amor a todos vós, amém.

findings.location: Paragraph beginning 'Do not create tumult...' / 'Suffer affliction rather than afflicting others.'
findings.source_quote: Suffer affliction rather than afflicting others. Suffer reproach rather than reproaching others. Be slandered rather than slandering others.
findings.suggested_fix: Fix typographical error in Portuguese verb 'Sofer' -> 'Sofrei' or 'Sofram' to follow chosen register and tense. Ensure imperative forms match the rest of the translation style.
findings.translation_quote: Sofer as aflições antes de afligir os outros. Sofrei a reprovação em vez de reprovar os outros. Sede caluniados antes de caluniares outros.
